fullDesc: On May 2, 2011 US Navy SEALs killed Osama bin Laden, mastermind of the 9/11 attacks, in a raid on his compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan. President Obama announced it that night.
realFacts: He had been hiding for nearly a decade
The operation was code-named Neptune Spear
A helicopter was lost in the raid
His body was buried at sea
